# stackit_containerregistry_artifactories (Data Source)

Container registry artifactories list data source schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  project_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

data "stackit_containerregistry_artifactories" "this" {
  project_id = local.project_id
}

output "artifactory_ids" {
  value = [for artifactory in data.stackit_containerregistry_artifactories.this.results : artifactory.artifactory_id]
}

# These expressions filter locally in Terraform; they are not API filters.
locals {
  exact_name          = [for artifactory in data.stackit_containerregistry_artifactories.this.results : artifactory if artifactory.name == "my-registry"]
  matching_names      = [for artifactory in data.stackit_containerregistry_artifactories.this.results : artifactory if can(regex("my-.*", artifactory.name))]
  proxy_artifactories = [for artifactory in data.stackit_containerregistry_artifactories.this.results : artifactory if artifactory.proxy != null]
  docker_hub_proxies  = [for artifactory in data.stackit_containerregistry_artifactories.this.results : artifactory if try(artifactory.proxy.registry_type, "") == "docker-hub"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) STACKIT project ID to which the container registry artifactories are associated.

### Optional

- `region` (String) STACKIT region where the container registry artifactories are located. If not defined, the provider default_region is used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform's internal data source ID, structured as `project_id`,`region`.
- `results` (Attributes List) List of container registry artifactories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `artifactory_id` (String) The unique identifier of the container registry artifactory.
- `create_time` (String) The date and time the creation of the STACKIT artifactory was triggered.
- `name` (String) A user-chosen name to distinguish multiple STACKIT artifactories.
- `proxy` (Attributes) Proxy configuration if this artifactory is created as a proxy-cache for an upstream registry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--proxy))
- `url` (String) The base URL of the STACKIT artifactory.

<a id="nestedatt--results--proxy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.proxy`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the upstream registry.
- `registry_type` (String) Which replication adapter to use for this registry.
- `url` (String) Upstream registry URL to proxy.
